from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

mol = Chem.MolFromMolFile("mol2d.mol", removeHs=False)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)
ref = Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False)
print("ref:", ref)

m = Chem.Mol(mol)
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=0xf00d, useRandomCoords=False)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m, maxIters=2000)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
new = Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False)
print("3d :", new)
print("match:", ref==new)
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m))

conf = m.GetConformer()
sym = [a.GetSymbol() for a in m.GetAtoms()]
with open("answer.xyz","w") as f:
    f.write("%d\n" % m.GetNumAtoms())
    f.write("mol_0091 3D structure\n")
    for i,a in enumerate(m.GetAtoms()):
        p = conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
        f.write("%-2s %12.6f %12.6f %12.6f\n" % (a.GetSymbol(), p.x, p.y, p.z))
print("written")
